title: Alarm indicator panel
goal: A reader must be able to trace the supervised normally closed alarm loop and distinguish healthy and alarm indications.

rubric.must: Three normally closed sensor switches labelled DOOR, WINDOW, and SMOKE are visibly in series.
A 24 VDC supply feeds the loop through a clearly labelled 500 mA fuse.
A green pilot light labelled HEALTHY is visible on the intact loop.
A 24 VDC relay coil labelled K1 ALARM RELAY is visible.
A buzzer and red ALARM pilot light are visibly in the alarm output branch.
A separate RESET NO pushbutton is visible.

ideal.notes: Reviewed. The normally-closed sensors sit in series in the supervised loop with the healthy lamp and relay coil at its end; the relay's break contact powers the buzzer and alarm lamp when the loop opens. The operating sequence is written out under the drawing.
